response.sql: WITH stats AS (SELECT SUM(traitcount)::float as total_pts, COUNT(*)::float as record_count FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL), shares AS (SELECT sf.zoneref, sf.traitcount, sf.traitcount / s.total_pts as share, 1.0 / s.record_count as avg_share FROM scanfeatures sf CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE sf.traitcount IS NOT NULL) SELECT zoneref, traitcount, share, (share - avg_share) as margin FROM shares WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY margin DESC LIMIT 10
